brief:
Israeli gunfire wounded two Palestinian children during a military raid on Qalandia refugee camp, north of occupied East Jerusalem, Wafa news agency reported. The shooting occurred as Israeli forces operated in the densely populated camp.

The ages of the wounded children and their conditions were not disclosed. No immediate statement explained the purpose of the raid or circumstances surrounding the shooting.

title: Israeli forces shoot two Palestinian children in Qalandia camp
